title: Recompose About, Contact and Experience with existing content
context: The owner requested stronger About and Contact design, then included Experience.
options: Recompose existing content using the homepage typography and color tokens.
choice: Use static layouts for identity, chronology and contact actions, retaining native Experience disclosures.
tradeoff: The arrangement needs more CSS and browser checks of wrapping, focus and reflow. It adds no motion or dependency.
